implementation.name: original-v4-03-chunk-supply-horizon
implementation.scope: Original direct-replacement timing strip. Exact chapter schedule and tracked-mug bound; no extra admission delay is charged. After replacement, the cursor inspects chunk 0 evidence and supply, not continued execution.
implementation.question: Why does buffered supply outlast permission?

purpose: Grow the original executed segment only until replacement, then inspect the retained first-chunk evidence and invalid supply tail without implying that the old chunk keeps acting. The original setpoint grid changes ownership: unavailable prefix, handed-off setpoints, discarded tail at replacement, and explicitly withheld expired remainder.
storyboard: Successor replaces chunk0; discard its queued tail
guard: Supply is not a lease or permission. Captured evidence ages before inference. Old chunk execution stops at replacement. Temporal ensembling and subsequent chunk executions are not simulated.
